messages:
sara (support): Hey billing — customer org-8273 (ACME Partners) reported a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows total usage $1,240.50 (12,405 tokens) for 2026-03-31 but invoice INV-2026-4521 shows $1,090.00 plus a separate negative line -$150.50 labeled 'pro-plan redistribution'. Customer insists they were on Standard the whole month. Can someone check why the redistribution credit appears on the invoice but not in the UI? Link: https://console.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-4521

ben (billing): assigning to billing-data. @maria can you take a look at metering + crediting pipeline? tagging @alex in case metrics/backfill plays a role.

maria (billing-data): quick summary from the pipeline side — dashboard uses the nearline aggregate store (usage_aggregates) keyed by (org, plan, date, window_end=23:59:00Z). Invoice generator replays ledger entries from invoice_lines created by the proration service. I see an entry in invoice_lines for org-8273: 

```sql
-- rows from invoice_lines for 2026-03-31, org-8273
SELECT id, org_id, kind, amount_cents, note, created_at
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE org_id = 'org-8273' AND invoice_date = '2026-03-31';
-- result:
-- 1001 | org-8273 | usage_charge | 109000 | 'usage: standard plan' | 2026-04-01T00:00:12Z
-- 1002 | org-8273 | credit       | -15050 | 'pro-plan redistribution' | 2026-03-31T23:59:58Z
```

maria (billing-data): The redistribution credit was generated by job redistrib-993 at 2026-03-31T23:59:58Z. That job reclassifies last-day usage when it detects a plan migration within the billing window. I can see a plan_change event for the account at 2026-03-31T23:59:50Z (api logs show plan_change: Standard -> Pro) — but customer claims they didn't migrate.

alex (eng-metrics): checking metrics/backfill side — we had a one-off KV-cache backfill in eu-west-1 this weekend (backfill-job: kv-backfill-2026-03-31). The backfill was scheduled with local timezone flags and replayed events with timestamps stamped in local time instead of normalized UTC. That could create a synthetic plan_change at 23:59 local that the redistribution job saw.

maria (billing-data): yep, correlates. The plan_change event that triggered redistrib-993 originated from the backfill replay. The dashboard's nearline aggregates are written by the realtime pipeline and we didn't replay to them in the same way — so dashboard never saw the plan_change/credit. Invoice generation replays ledger events (including the redistrib job) and included the credit.

ben (billing): OK actionable items: 1) undo the redistribution for org-8273 and regenerate invoice (or apply manual adjustment) 2) fix backfill timezone config to prevent more plan_change replays 3) audit window to find other affected accounts and notify customers if needed. @maria you own 1 and 3, @alex you own 2. I'll coordinate refunds if needed.

maria (billing-data): running a dry-run recompute now to see delta before applying. Command I used: 

```bash
# dry-run recompute invoice lines for org-8273 for 2026-03-31
billing-cli recompute --org org-8273 --date 2026-03-31 --dry-run --job-tag redistrib-audit-2165
```

maria (billing-data): dry-run output: 
-- recompute summary: original_total_cents = 124050, recomputed_total_cents = 139100, delta_cents = +15050 (meaning invoice currently subtracts 15050 credit that recompute would remove). It lists the redistrib line id 1002 as the only differing line.

maria (billing-data): proceeding with live recompute (no dry-run) now. I'll keep the job in readonly until we confirm. If it looks clean I'll push the invoice update and queue a refund for the negative credit.

billing-bot: job redistrib-audit-2165 started at 2026-04-01T02:12:09Z (job-id: recompute-5567)

maria (billing-data): recompute completed. Invoice INV-2026-4521 updated: removed invoice_line 1002, new invoice total matches dashboard $1,240.50. Refund of $150.50 (orig cents 15050) queued to payment system (refund-id RFND-7782).

ben (billing): great — can you add the affected count audit? we need a short list for comms.

maria (billing-data): ran audit query against redistrib-993 affected rows. Found 18 orgs impacted (mostly EU accounts processed by kv-backfill-2026-03-31). I'll export CSV and drop in #finance-private.

alex (eng-metrics): backfill timezone bug fixed (PR #4872 merged). Deployed to prod backfill controller. Added a post-run sanity check to compare plan_change events count between realtime and backfill.

sara (support): Thanks everyone. I'll update ACME Partners: told them we removed the redistribution credit, invoice updated, refund queued, and this was caused by an internal backfill job which we've fixed. Will offer a brief postmortem if they'd like.

ben (billing): filing a short incident note for ops: incident-2026-04-01-billing-redistrib. Maria can you attach the CSV of affected orgs and a one-paragraph root cause?

maria (billing-data): done — attached CSV and root-cause blurb in the incident doc. I put a temporary monitor on redistrib job frequency and added a ticket to add end-to-end test coverage for invoice vs dashboard parity.

sara (support): Customer notified, pleased with quick response. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
